### Outcome update — TATASTEEL_NS-3b9e07c2 (TATASTEEL)

- **LOSS**, P&L Rs -12,400
- Gapped through the stop on a global metals selloff; filled 1.8% below the 161.10 level.

> **Lesson.** The modelled stop was never the real stop. On a commodity-linked
> name where the driver is an overnight offshore market, size for the gap and
> not for the intraday stop distance, or express the view with defined risk.
